description.html: Gecko Nutrition Mango Papaya is a complete powdered diet made in Germany, specially designed for crested geckos and other fruit-eating (frugivorous) reptiles. This variety stands out as the only one in the entire Gecko Nutrition line that does not contain banana, making it an ideal choice for owners who want to add variety to the diet or whose geckos prefer different flavors. Instead of banana, the formula relies on juicy mango (13%) and mild papaya (13%), creating a harmonious tropical burst of flavor. Notably, this variety contains a higher share of insects - 14% compared to the standard 11% in other varieties - which results in a higher crude protein content of 26.7%. The protein component consists of black soldier fly larvae, mealworms and crickets, which provide complete proteins with all essential amino acids. Crude fat content is 5.3% and calcium 2%, ensuring a balanced nutritional profile. Papaya is known for enzymes that aid digestion, while mango is a rich source of vitamins A and C.

To prepare a meal, mix one part powder with two parts water (1:2 ratio) until you get a smooth, creamy mixture. Offer the prepared food to your geckos in a shallow dish in the evening, because these animals are most active at night. The recommended feeding schedule is 2-3 evenings a week. Always remove uneaten food after 24 hours to prevent bacterial growth and keep the terrarium clean. In addition to the complete diet, occasionally offer live insects dusted with a calcium supplement. Store the unopened pack in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight.
Crested geckos and other fruit-eating (frugivorous) reptiles.
